factual_claims.source_evidence: Earnings per share note shows SEK -0.20 (2025) vs SEK 1.37 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The report states that implementation of the new warehouse automation affected results during parts of the year, while the company also operated in an industry characterized by intense competition, profit warnings and structural shifts.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report mentions automation implementation impact and CEO statement describes industry challenges.

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation improved substantially.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow from operating activities increased to SEK 527.5m from SEK 209.7m.

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities increased to SEK 527.5 million from SEK 209.7 million, while total cash flow rose to SEK 327.3 million from SEK 71.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows operating cash flow of SEK 527.5m (2025) vs SEK 209.7m (2024) and total cash flow of SEK 327.3m vs SEK 71.7m.

factual_claims.claim: Investing cash flow increased to SEK -351.2 million, mainly reflecting the new warehouse automation, store openings and digital development.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement attributes investing cash flow of -SEK 351.2m to warehouse automation, store openings, and digital development.

factual_claims.claim: The Vansbro automation investment was approximately SEK 500 million and, once fully operational in early 2026, is designed to handle up to approximately 100,000 orders per day.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Vansbro warehouse section states investment of approximately SEK 500m with capacity for up to 100,000 orders per day.

factual_claims.claim: The company ended the year with SEK 452.5 million in cash, compared with SEK 140.5 million previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents on balance sheet: SEK 452.5m (2025) vs SEK 140.5m (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Net debt excluding IFRS 16 declined to SEK 292.5 million from SEK 333.1 million, although total interest-bearing liabilities including leases increased to SEK 1,416.3 million from SEK 1,169.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial position section states net debt excluding IFRS 16 was SEK 292.5m (2025) vs SEK 333.1m (2024), with interest-bearing liabilities including leases at SEK 1,416.3m vs SEK 1,169.3m.

factual_claims.claim: The equity ratio decreased to 14.8% from 20.3%, reflecting significant balance-sheet expansion and increased borrowing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial position section shows equity ratio of 14.8% (2025) vs 20.3% (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Major developments included the opening of two stores, Lyko’s first Fab Store in Täby, the relaunch of Make Up Store, the launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory, and continued investment in own brands, logistics and customer engagement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Selected events section details Fab Store opening, Make Up Store relaunch, Scandinavian Soap Factory launch, and ongoing investments.

factual_claims.claim: No dividend is proposed for 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Share section states 'The Board does not intend to propose any dividend for the current fiscal year.'
